items.title: Existence of the lower shriek functor on modules for a continuous and cocontinuous functor between sites
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-modules.tex (Modules on Sites)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a functor g_! on modules, left adjoint to g^*, for a continuous and cocontinuous functor u between sites when the structure sheaf of the source is the pullback of that of the target. The proof computes the Hom-set from a standard generator j_{U!}O_U into g^{-1}G and identifies it successively with the value of g^{-1}G at U, with G at u(U), and finally with the Hom-set from j_{u(U)!}O_{u(U)} into G, which exhibits the required adjunction; the general case follows by presenting modules by such generators (proof lines 8236-8256). H2: the chain of identifications computing the Hom-sets is the substance and is carried out explicitly.
